correctness.rationale: The coordinate garbling sends rare output probability q=a+(1-a)ρ to (1-q)a/(1-a)=a(1-ρ); its unchanged stochastic matrix is nonnegative for all 0<a≤1/2, including the swap at equality. Tensoring gives the identity simultaneously in ρ for every input. Integrating or differentiating a finite row preserves the identity and stochastic contraction holds for complex row vectors. Multiplying the kernel by μ(x) gives a symmetric matrix even for complex combinations, so the L¹ induced norm (max weighted column absolute sum normalized at the input) equals the L∞ norm (max row absolute sum). At endpoints the derivatives extend polynomially or by the chain rule in time. The channel itself is parameter-independent and remains stochastic; it is the resampling-law interpretation that the interval in the assumptions guarantees. For equal biases, each rare-start mass depends only on the level j. The derivative of (1-q+qz)^n is (n)_k(z-1)^k(1-q+qz)^(n-k); this proves the stated signed difference and vanishing above degree n. For k=1, the total variation of consecutive binomial masses padded with zeros is twice the maximal mass, also for a tied mode, a singleton mass at q=1 or n=1. Interior Hermite convergence can be checked from the score S=k!e_k(η_1,…,η_n), where η_i=(Y_i-q)/(q(1-q)) for iid Bernoulli(q). The normalized power sums of η converge for orders 1 and 2 by the CLT and LLN and vanish above order 2, giving the fixed-order coefficient limit. Distinct k-subset products are orthogonal, yielding the required uniform second moment and absolute-moment convergence. At the boundary the complementary binomial law converges in total variation to Poisson(λ), which controls the maximal atom and its integer-mode ties. The supplied exact rational verifier was inspected without execution; it checks finite row maxima, homogeneous derivative differences and peak formulas, not general asymptotics or every complex mixture. Replay paths for the all-parameter proof and corroborative checks are RESULT.md steps 1–5 and check.py in the source package.
